","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","Title":"CHAPTER 7 - CITY MUNICIPAL UTILITIES BILLING CODE","Content":"

\n SECTION :\n


Footnotes:

Editor's note—\n Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, adopted June 21, 2016, amended ch. 7 in its entirety to read\n as herein set out. Former ch. 7, §§ 7-7-1—7-7-26, pertained to similar subject matter,\n and derived from Ord. 560, adopted Feb. 12, 2001; and Ord. No. 2016-09, § 1, adopted\n May 3, 2016.\n

\n
","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":735,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-1: - SHORT TITLE AND PURPOSE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-1SHTIPU","Title":"7-7-1: - SHORT TITLE AND PURPOSE:","Content":"
\n

\n This chapter shall be known as the city municipal utilities billing code, and is enacted\n to provide for the health, safety and welfare of the people of Kuna, Idaho.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":736,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-2: - DEFINITIONS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-2DE","Title":"7-7-2: - DEFINITIONS:","Content":"
\n

\n CITY'S MUNICIPAL UTILITIES:\n \n

\n MUNICIPAL POTABLE WATER SYSTEM means that portion of the city's potable water system line upstream from the valve\n box, inclusive of the city water main and fittings, water service the corporation\n stop, valve box, meter and meter yoke, as further defined in KCC, tit. 7, ch. 5. The\n portion of the water service referenced is owned and maintained by the city and will\n usually be installed within the limits of the public right-of-way or utility easement.\n The city is not responsible for the maintenance or repair of the waterline downstream\n from the city's meter.\n

\n \n

\n MUNICIPAL SANITARY SEWER SYSTEM means that portion of the city sewer system line inclusive of the city's sewer main\n and fittings, as further defined in KCC tit. 7, ch. 6. The portion of the sewer service\n referenced is owned and maintained by the city and will usually be installed within\n the limits of the public right-of-way.\n

\n \n

\n MUNICIPAL PRESSURIZED IRRIGATION SYSTEM means that portion of the city's pressurized irrigation system line upstream from\n the valve box, inclusive of the city pressurize irrigation main and fittings, pressurized\n irrigation service corporation stop, valve box, as further defined in KCC tit. 7,\n ch. 8. The portion of the pressurized irrigation service referenced is owned and maintained\n by the city and will usually be installed within the limits of the public right-of-way\n or utility easement. The city is not responsible for the maintenance or repair of\n the pressurized irrigation service line downstream from the valve box.\n

\n \n

\n The three (3) systems may be referred to as the city's municipal utilities.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":737,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-3: - APPLICABILITY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-3AP","Title":"7-7-3: - APPLICABILITY:","Content":"
\n

\n The provisions of the chapter apply to all property located within the corporate limits\n of the city, and special users outside the corporate limits of the city.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":738,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-4: - POWERS AND AUTHORITY OF CITY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-4POAUCI","Title":"7-7-4: - POWERS AND AUTHORITY OF CITY:","Content":"
\n

\n The city shall be permitted to, at reasonable hours of the day or at any time an emergency\n exists, enter all properties, premises or buildings to which municipal water or sewer\n is furnished for the purpose of testing or for any other purpose necessary for the\n proper administration of the city's municipal utilities in accordance with this chapter.\n

\n

\n The city shall be permitted to enter all private properties through which the city\n holds an easement for the purpose of, but not limited to, inspection, observation,\n repair, and maintenance of any portion of the city's municipal utilities located within\n said easements.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":739,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-5: - APPLICATION FOR UTILITY SERVICES:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-5APUTSE","Title":"7-7-5: - APPLICATION FOR UTILITY SERVICES:","Content":"
\n

\n An application shall be required for all new accounts for all property owners or entities\n receiving city municipal utilities as provided for by this chapter, or for those accounts\n to be updated as determined necessary by the city utility billing department.\n

\n

\n The application shall be provided to the new account owner at the title company where\n the purchase is to close, and the application shall be completed prior to or at the\n time of closing. At closing, the title company shall provide via electronic transmission,\n a copy of the deed and the completed application.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":740,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-6: - CONTENTS OF APPLICATION:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-6COAP","Title":"7-7-6: - CONTENTS OF APPLICATION:","Content":"
\n

\n The application for city municipal utilities service shall contain the name of the\n real property owner (account owner) and any agent of the property owner (property\n management company); the physical address of the real property; complete mailing address\n for billing statements; e-mail address; alternate address and phone number; the day\n time and evening telephone numbers; and if the real property is owner occupied or\n a rental unit.\n

\n

\n The application shall also contain a contract that includes a provision executed by\n the owner of the real property or the legally authorized agent, agreeing to: pay for\n the utility service applied for, at the rate, at the times, and in the manner specified\n in this title; that the city is acknowledged by him/her to reserve the right to charge\n and collect such rates; to impose and enforce the penalties provided for in this title;\n to change the rate at any time without notice to the user; and to install such meters\n or other devices as may be necessary to control and measure the utility service supplied.\n Said contract shall also specifically provide that the city shall not be held responsible\n for any damage by water or otherwise resulting from failure of the plumbing or appliances\n on the premises supplied with water, nor for any damage caused by the interruption\n or failure of such supply, nor shall such failure or interruption be held to constitute\n a breach of contract on the part of the city, nor in any way release the user from\n the performance of all of his/her obligations as therein set forth. No application\n for utility service shall be granted, or if inadvertently granted, shall be continued,\n until the contract(s) as provided for herein have been properly executed.\n

\n

\n New construction: For utility service for new construction, the application shall include the location,\n type of building, and uses therein, the purpose for which the services are to be used,\n number of persons to be supplied or other indication for probable consumption, the\n number of EDUs, as calculated by city staff. As part of the application process, the\n applicant shall furnish a set of floor plans showing all water and sewer uses and,\n where permissible, a site plan if the water is to be used for irrigation. If the application\n is approved, the public works department may authorize the extension, at the expense\n of the applicant, and at no expense to the city, the service pipe and meter tile,\n meter yoke, meter tile lid, curb stop and any other fittings that are necessary to\n install service to the inside line of the curb or back edge of sidewalk at the point\n for supplying the applicant.\n

\n

\n Existing water service: For utility service for a property that has previous utility service, if the property\n is sold or otherwise transferred, the new owner of the property shall make application\n to the city utility billing department and shall execute all forms and other documents\n required by the city in order to receive service. Until the property transfers to\n the new owner, the then current account holder shall remain responsible for all accrued\n charges.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":741,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-6a: - THIRD PARTY BILLING AGENT:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-6ATHPABIAG","Title":"7-7-6a: - THIRD PARTY BILLING AGENT:","Content":"
\n

\n An account owner may appoint an agent (property management company) to receive billings\n on the form provided by the city. The contract appointing the agent shall require\n that the signature of the account owner of the property is subscribed and sworn.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":742,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-6b: - SECONDARY RECIPIENT OF BILLS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-6BSEREBI","Title":"7-7-6b: - SECONDARY RECIPIENT OF BILLS:","Content":"
\n

\n If the property is to be non-owner occupied, the appointed agent and the tenant may\n receive a duplicate of the bill for city utility services by email address, as set\n up by the account owner through the city's online bill processing system, when available.\n In the event the account becomes delinquent, the city utility billing department shall\n transmit a shut off warning that is printed on the next utility billing statement\n and/or by separate notice transmitted to both the account owner, the third party billing\n recipient and tenant at the email addresses as set up by the account owner in the\n secondary recipient of bills, as provided for in this section. The third party billing\n agreement shall also provide that the owner of the real property remains financially\n responsible for charges assessed to the account, and further, that all unpaid charges\n together with fees, costs and interest, shall constitute a lien against the real property,\n as provided for in this chapter.\n

\n

\n The city shall have the right to request from each account owner the current account\n information, including name of property owner, if the property is owner occupied or\n a rental, billing address, telephone number and email address.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":743,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-6c: - LIEN:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-6CLI","Title":"7-7-6c: - LIEN:","Content":"
\n

\n The application shall also contain a contract provision providing that the owner of\n the property contracting with the city expressly gives consent to the placement of\n a lien upon the property in the event charges for utility services become delinquent\n and unpaid and said lien shall be recorded with the Ada County Recorder's Office.\n The contract shall require that the signature of the account owner of the property\n is subscribed and sworn. The lien shall be for the total amount due, plus interest\n and an administrative fee, as set by resolution of the city council, to reimburse\n the city its administrative expenses.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":744,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-7: - CITY PRESSURIZED IRRIGATION SYSTEM PAYMENTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-7CIPRIRSYPA","Title":"7-7-7: - CITY PRESSURIZED IRRIGATION SYSTEM PAYMENTS:","Content":"
\n

\n All account owners agree that the city may prorate the municipal irrigation assessment\n on the monthly bill in nine (9) equal payments with the first payment being billed\n in October and the last payment being billed in June. If a new account is established\n after October, then the new account owner shall pay any past month(s), so his/her\n account is then current. In addition, the account holder agrees that if their property\n is part of a subdivision that has HOA common lot or lots that receive a separate municipal\n irrigation assessment, the account owner agrees to pay a fractional share of the HOA\n assessment if the HOA association fails to pay the same before May 31st.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":745,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-8: - ACCOUNT DISCOUNT:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-8ACDI","Title":"7-7-8: - ACCOUNT DISCOUNT:","Content":"
\n

\n All account owners who: 1) reside at the property as the primary residents, and 2)\n have reached the age of sixty-five (65) years of age: may receive a discount off the\n potable water and trash portion of the bill as established by resolution of the city\n council.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":746,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-9: - INDIGENCY ASSISTANCE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-9INAS","Title":"7-7-9: - INDIGENCY ASSISTANCE:","Content":"
\n

\n If an account owner or tenant is experiencing a financial hardship where he/she is\n unable to pay their bill in full, may make application for assistance from the city's\n indigency fund if funds have been appropriated by city council, assistance to be determined\n by the city council during a closed hearing.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":747,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-10: - PAYMENT DUE DATE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-10PADUDA","Title":"7-7-10: - PAYMENT DUE DATE:","Content":"
\n

\n On or about the first day of each month, the utility billing department shall cause\n to be mailed or transmitted to each utility account owner, a statement of the amount\n due for water, sewer, irrigation, trash collection, and other charges for the preceding\n month; said amount is due and payable to the utility billing department on or before\n the fifteenth day of each month.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":748,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-11: - DELINQUENT ACCOUNTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-11DEAC","Title":"7-7-11: - DELINQUENT ACCOUNTS:","Content":"
\n

\n All utility bills are considered delinquent if not paid to the city before the sixteenth\n day of each month.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":749,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-12: - LATE FEE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-12LAFE","Title":"7-7-12: - LATE FEE:","Content":"
\n

\n If the utility bill is not paid in full by the fifteenth day of the month following\n the bill's original due date, the city shall charge a late fee of fifteen dollars\n ($15.00) for each account with a balance greater than fifteen dollars ($15.00). This\n late fee shall be added to the city utility account.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":750,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-13: - ACCOUNT SHUT-OFF WARNING:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-13ACSHFWA","Title":"7-7-13: - ACCOUNT SHUT-OFF WARNING:","Content":"
\n

\n If the account becomes more than thirty (30) days delinquent, the city utility billing\n department shall transmit a shut-off warning that is printed on the next utility billing\n statement and/or by separate notice to be transmitted to the email address and/or\n automated dialer service as set up by the account owner.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":751,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-14: - ACCOUNT SHUT-OFF WATER SERVICE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-14ACSHFWASE","Title":"7-7-14: - ACCOUNT SHUT-OFF WATER SERVICE:","Content":"
\n

\n Effective on and after November 16, 2016, if a city utility account is two (2) billing\n cycles past original due date the water will be shut-off on the following Tuesday.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":752,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-15: - ACCOUNT TURN-ON WATER SERVICE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-15ACTUWASE","Title":"7-7-15: - ACCOUNT TURN-ON WATER SERVICE:","Content":"
\n

\n Effective on and after November 16, 2016, when water has been turned off because of\n non-payment of the city utility account, the water shall not be turned on until the\n account is paid in full, including any charges or fees that may have accrued since\n the last bill, plus the administrative fee of fifty dollars ($50.00) to the city's\n utility billing office. Upon receipt of payment, the city's utility billing department\n will contact the appropriate department to turn the water on. The services shall be\n turned on within twenty-four (24) hours of receipt of payment excluding weekends and\n holidays.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":753,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-16: - NOTICE OF SHUT-OFF WATER SERVICE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-16NOSHFWASE","Title":"7-7-16: - NOTICE OF SHUT-OFF WATER SERVICE:","Content":"
\n

\n If an account has been shut-off for non-payment pursuant to the terms of this chapter,\n the city shall place a shut-off notice on the door knob, latch or other conspicuous\n location at the serviced premises notice that the utility service has been shut off\n or if an account is set up for electronic delivery of emails and/or automated dialer\n service, the shut-off notice may be transmitted by these methods in lieu of posting\n the notice on the property.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":754,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-17: - NONPAYMENT OF ACCOUNT:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-17NOAC","Title":"7-7-17: - NONPAYMENT OF ACCOUNT:","Content":"
\n

\n Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as modifying or repealing the right or\n obligation of the city to discontinue water service for nonpayment of trash and municipal\n utility charges.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":755,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-18: - COLLECTION OF AGED ACCOUNT:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-18COAGAC","Title":"7-7-18: - COLLECTION OF AGED ACCOUNT:","Content":"
\n

\n On a monthly basis, the city billing clerk shall submit to the city engineer, city\n attorney and city treasurer, a listing of all the accounts and amounts that are sixty\n (60) and ninety (90) days delinquent. On accounts that are more than ninety (90) days\n delinquent, the city attorney is authorized to record a lien against the properties,\n if the provisions of this chapter have been complied with, and/or the city attorney\n or city treasurer is authorized to send the accounts to a collection agency, as approved\n by the city.\n

\n

\n If an account is more than ninety (90) days past due, two (2) or more times within\n any twelve-month period of time, the city reserves the right to report the account\n owner's delinquency to the credit reporting agencies.\n

\n

\n The city shall also create a list of all persons that are delinquent more than ninety\n (90) days.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":756,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-19: - NOTATION ON MONTHLY BILLING STATEMENTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-19NOMOBIST","Title":"7-7-19: - NOTATION ON MONTHLY BILLING STATEMENTS:","Content":"
\n

\n On all monthly utility billing statements, the following notation shall appear:\n

\n

\n Interest shall accrue at the rate of (1 ½%)/month (18% annually), which shall be added\n to any utility bill not paid within ninety (90) days past the due date thereof.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":757,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-20: - SECURITY DEPOSIT REQUIRED:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-20SEDERE","Title":"7-7-20: - SECURITY DEPOSIT REQUIRED:","Content":"
\n

\n Security deposit: Upon application for service, the city shall require all account owners to pay a\n refundable deposit to the city in the amount of one hundred dollars ($100.00) for\n each opened utility account. The deposit shall be held for the term of the account\n and it is non-transferable. Upon closing of an account, the deposit shall be used\n to pay any balance on the account and the remaining funds will be returned to the\n account holder.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":758,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-21: - UNCLAIMED DEPOSITS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-21UNDE","Title":"7-7-21: - UNCLAIMED DEPOSITS:","Content":"
\n

\n All deposits held, pursuant to this chapter, by the City of Kuna, where the City of\n Kuna is unable to locate the account owner or tenant of the property, shall be processed\n in accordance with state law.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":759,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-22: - CRIMINAL PENALTIES:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-22CRPE","Title":"7-7-22: - CRIMINAL PENALTIES:","Content":"
\n

\n Illegal connections: It shall be unlawful for any person to make or cause to be made any connection with\n the municipal utility system, or to introduce or cause to be introduced water from\n the municipal potable water system or pressurized irrigation system into any connection\n made therewith unless a permit has been first duly issued for such purpose by the\n building inspection in compliance and conformity with the provision of this chapter\n and the rules and regulations of the city that are now or may hereafter be established\n therefor; or to cause a connection to become in noncompliance with the provision of\n this chapter and the rules and regulation of the city that are now or may hereafter\n be established; or to interfere with or injure any hydrant, pipe connection, meter\n or any property of the municipal water system.\n

\n

\n Illegal restoration: It shall be unlawful for any person, who having had the water turned off from a city\n property being provided municipal utilities service, to turn on, or have another person,\n turn the municipal water on. Only a city employee may turn on the municipal water\n after payment in full has been made.\n

\n

\n False representation: It shall be unlawful for any person who is not the legal owner of the real property,\n receiving or requesting municipal utility services for such real property, to represent\n upon an application for utility services or contract that such person is the legal\n owner of the real property for which utility service is being requested; nor shall\n a person make any other false representation for the purpose of receiving such services.\n

\n

\n A violation of this section shall be considered a misdemeanor punishable by the provisions\n of KCC 1-4-1.\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":760,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-7-23: - SEVERABILITY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-23SE","Title":"7-7-23: - SEVERABILITY:","Content":"
\n

\n If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or any part of this chapter shall be\n declared and adjudged to be invalid or unconstitutional by a court of competent jurisdiction,\n such invalidity or unconstitutionality shall not affect, invalidate, or nullify the\n remainder of this chapter.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n

7-7-24: - EFFECTIVE DATE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH7CIMUUTBICO_7-7-24EFDA","Title":"7-7-24: - EFFECTIVE DATE:","Content":"
\n

\n The ordinance codified in this chapter shall become effective August 31, 2016.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2016-09A, § 1, 6-21-2016)\n
